title: Coverage Cliffs in Off-Policy Quantile Certification
abstract: arXiv:2610.22565v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study when logged contextual-bandit data can certify an upper tail quantile for a policy selected from the same sample. We construct a PAC-Bayes Bernstein lower-confidence envelope for the target cumulative distribution function (CDF), simultaneous over a predeclared threshold grid and all data-dependent posteriors. The resulting procedure, TailCert, uses the envelope's first crossing of level p to return an atom-safe upper confidence bound on the selected posterior's pooled p-quantile (or inconclusive). It can also be used to select a policy under a certified tail constraint. The concentration ingredients are standard; the main theoretical contribution is a matched finite-class certification boundary comparing full logs with their joint weighted CDF indicators at a fixed threshold. translated_title: 离策略分位数认证中的覆盖悬崖
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在什么条件下已记录的上下文老虎机数据能够为从同一样本中选出的策略认证一个上尾分位数。我们为目标累积分布函数（CDF）构建了一个 PAC-Bayes Bernstein 下置信包络，该包络在预先声明的阈值网格和所有依赖数据的后验分布上同时有效。由此得到的程序 TailCert 利用该包络首次穿越水平 p 的位置，返回所选后验的池化 p 分位数的一个原子安全的上置信界（或返回无法判定）。该程序还可以在经过认证的尾部约束下用于策略选择。其中的集中不等式成分都是标准工具；主要的理论贡献是一个匹配的有限类认证边界，它在固定阈值下比较完整日志数据与其联合加权 CDF 指示变量。在一个显式的稀有动作类上，所需样本量随重叠因子 W 线性增长，随策略搜索和置信度参数对数增长……
tldr: 本文提出 TailCert 程序，通过构建 PAC-Bayes Bernstein 下置信包络，利用已记录的上下文老虎机数据安全地为离策略选择认证上尾分位数，并揭示了在稀有动作类上所需样本量随重叠因子线性增长、随策略搜索与置信度参数对数增长的定量规律。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes TailCert, a PAC-Bayes Bernstein lower-confidence envelope-based procedure that safely certifies upper tail quantiles of policies selected from logged contextual-bandit data, showing that the required sample size grows linearly with the overlap factor and logarithmically with policy-search and confidence parameters on rare-action classes.
